Components.Content:
A pink bird loved by many, despite
its legs not being of optimal
condition due to _____
Please take care of this poor animal!!!

Observe the animal to know how to 
care for it!!!

The animal is idle-no extra care 
is needed now!!!
The animal is hungry-feed the flamingo now!!!

Drag the food to the animal 
when it's hungry!!!
The animal is sick-cure the flamingo now!!!

A red dot marks the pain spot. 
Drag the injection onto it to heal the animal.
The animal is angry-find its hidden toy to calm it!!!

Toy found-the flamingo is calm. In-game, 
look for hiding spots and click to uncover 
the toy.

Use the log to infer whether the animal is 
IDLE, HUNGRY, SICK, or ANGRY.

Timer indicates time elapsed since 
the game started

Congrats! You've completed the tutorial. Now 
you can move on to the main game
